title: Encode Engram's assurance ladder once and move the older refusal predicates beside it
outcome:
Follow-up from the tm-winf step-1b round-5 review (Claude /review-code, Low and Note). Step 1b added src/engram_evaluation_refusal.rs with engram_evaluation_refusal_heals_by_rebind, engram_host_assurance_covers and engram_assurance_rank (advisory < turn_gated < action_gated, compared against ENGRAM_CONTROL_ASSURANCE). Two duplicates remain:

1. src/engram_readiness.rs (around line 203) hard-codes a matches! over the literal levels advisory and turn_gated for the same question, so a new or reordered Engram level could drift between the two encodings. Switch it to engram_host_assurance_covers / engram_assurance_rank.
2. The older pure refusal predicates in engram_host_adapter.rs (engram_evaluation_refusal_requires_rebind, engram_error_is_stale_fence, engram_begin_refusal_allows_reevaluation, engram_status_error_requires_fresh_bind) have no AppState dependency and belong in the same fragment. Move them in a pure code-move commit (no renames or signature changes), shrinking the 6.6k-line adapter.
